lines.text: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron, his sons and the elders, and told Aaron to have Israel bring offerings.
Aaron slaughtered the ram as his sin offering and burned its flesh and hide outside the camp.
Aaron's sons brought him the burnt offering's blood, and he splattered it on all sides of the altar.
Aaron burned the fat portions on the altar, but he waved the breasts and the left thigh before the LORD.
Fire from the LORD consumed the burnt offering and fat portions, and the people shouted for joy and fell facedown.
